record.paper_title: Measurement of Energy Spectrum and Elemental Composition of PeV Cosmic Rays: Open Problems and Prospects
record.original_question: What physical sources, acceleration mechanisms, and propagation processes produce the observed population of cosmic rays, especially Galactic cosmic rays in and above the PeV range, given that the all-particle energy spectrum contains features such as the knee, second knee, ankle, and high-energy cutoff, but ground-based measurements still disagree in ways that may reflect unknown systematic uncertainties?

evidence.quote: More than one century after their discovery, we have no definitive models yet about the origin, acceleration and propagation processes of the radiation. The main reason is that there are still significant discrepancies among the results obtained by different experiments located at ground level, probably due to unknown systematic uncertainties affecting the measurements.

All the observed features are believed to carry fundamental information that sheds light on the key questions of the origin, acceleration and propagation of CRs. However, from the all-particle results alone, it is not possible to understand the origin of different features.

artifact.status_search_result: The origin, acceleration, and propagation of PeV-scale Galactic cosmic rays remain open questions in astroparticle physics. Although supernova remnants are widely considered the main candidates (and recent gamma-ray observations by LHAASO have identified PeVatron candidates), no definitive model accounts for all observed spectral features and composition data, and experimental discrepancies persist.

status_evidence.title: LHAASO discovery of PeVatrons
status_evidence.snippet: LHAASO has detected ultra-high-energy gamma rays indicating Galactic PeVatron sources, but identification of individual cosmic-ray accelerators producing the knee remains incomplete.
status_evidence.claim: The sources of PeV Galactic cosmic rays are not yet definitively identified.

status_evidence.title: Cosmic Ray Reviews (PDG)
status_evidence.snippet: Standard reviews note that the origin of the knee and the precise transition to extragalactic cosmic rays are still debated.
status_evidence.claim: The origin/acceleration/propagation problem for PeV cosmic rays is open.
